segment_contamination_dimensions: Used/second-hand PEB buyers: sibling taxonomy does not carve this out explicitly, but Agent 3 product_types includes 'Second-hand / used PEB structure' as a distinct sub-segment with a different buyer persona (cost-constrained buyers seeking pre-owned lots vs. new-build industrial developers); names containing 'used', 'second-hand', 'pre-owned', or 'refurbished' are discarded to avoid attracting that incompatible buyer segment — the buyer_intent_query 'used second hand PEB building structure' was removed from alt_names on this basis.

Light Gauge Steel Frame (LGSF) buyers: sibling 'Light Gauge Framing System' (ID 410918) targets a structurally distinct buyer segment (residential/low-load applications using cold-formed light-gauge sections) incompatible with the heavy industrial PEB buyer; names or alt_names terms foregrounding 'LGSF' or 'light gauge' are discarded to prevent cross-segment contamination.

Agricultural/greenhouse buyers: siblings 'Agricultural Greenhouses', 'Agricultural Buildings', 'Greenhouse', 'Polyhouse', 'Naturally Ventilated Greenhouse', 'Mini Greenhouse', 'Greenhouse Structure' all target agri-horticulture buyers with fundamentally different use contexts and price tiers; no PEB name candidate uses greenhouse, polyhouse, or agri-shed framing.

Tensile/membrane structure buyers: siblings 'Tensile Structures', 'Modular Tensile Structure', 'Tensile Membrane Structures', 'Auditorium Tensile Structure', 'Gazebo Tensile Structure' target fabric/membrane structure buyers incompatible with rigid steel frame PEB buyers; tensile-related terms are excluded from all name candidates.

Modular/portable/temporary building buyers: siblings 'Modular Buildings', 'Portable Buildings', 'Temporary Buildings', 'Prefabricated Labor Colony', 'Prefabricated Isolation Ward' target relocatable or temporary-use buyers distinct from permanent industrial PEB buyers; modular, portable, temporary, and labour-colony framing is excluded.
